name: Casual Leave
infoNote: Includes sick leave. CL + PL = 24 days.

name: Privilege Leave
infoNote: 0.8 day/month, credited quarterly (Jan/Apr/Jul/Sep). Carry-forward capped at 5 days.

name: Optional Holiday
infoNote: Floating holiday for festivals not on the org calendar.

name: Sabbatical
infoNote: 1 month, unpaid. Requires Manager and HR approval.

name: Loss of Pay
infoNote: Only available once Casual Leave and Privilege Leave balances are both exhausted. Capped at 15 working days/year.

name: Public Holiday
infoNote: Not applied for — driven by the organization's holiday calendar (see public_holiday table).
